claims.quote: Tixmancer is a conversational web app for people who hunt for secondhand finds.
claims.proposed_statement: Tixmancer is a conversational product for people looking for secondhand finds.
claims.required_qualifier: Describe the product, without claiming public production access.
claims.editorial_assessment: Direct positioning sentence; no market-demand inference.

claims.quote:
Tix helps secondhand buyers and sellers make the next decision. A buyer can
describe an item, location and limit. A seller can bring a listing and ask for
help with the offer. The product starts as a conversation so the user does not
have to learn a parser or fill a dashboard before Tix understands the job.
claims.proposed_statement: The intended starting point is a conversation about the item, location and personal price limit.
claims.required_qualifier: Use design/preview framing; do not claim a live external search.
claims.editorial_assessment: The proposed wording describes the input and intended interaction, not an external result.

claims.quote:
The price comparison is deterministic. Tix compares the asking price in a
record with the user’s limit. Market value remains unknown until the product
has a supported evidence source.
claims.proposed_statement: Tix compares an asking price with the buyer’s chosen limit. That comparison alone does not establish market value.
claims.required_qualifier: Refer to the selected preview behavior. Preserve the distinction between under budget and below market value.
claims.editorial_assessment: The quote explicitly defines the comparison and its limit.

claims.quote:
The preview starts with a clean account. Google sign-in establishes identity.
The account owns its conversations, saved facts and preview records. Vercel AI
Gateway supplies the language model.
claims.proposed_statement: The selected preview code is designed around account-owned conversations and saved context.
claims.required_qualifier: Code/design only; deployed Google sign-in and AI Gateway acceptance were not tested here.
claims.editorial_assessment: Source and focused code inspection support presence; the copy must not convert that into production acceptance.

claims.quote:
Marketplace search, listing retrieval, connector delivery, wallet funding and
checkout are simulated services. They produce stored records from the user’s
own item and location. The interface labels those records as simulated. It does
not present synthetic listings or wallet actions as live external events.
claims.proposed_statement: The selected preview uses stored simulations for marketplace, notification and wallet steps.
claims.required_qualifier: Keep this boundary in explanations of what can be tried; a product-vision scene proves no real external event.
claims.editorial_assessment: This is direct contrary evidence against live search/payment claims.

claims.quote:
The next product slices are account-owned active hunts, listing photo and file
attachments, live supported marketplace sources, user-selected notification
connectors, and an optional permissioned wallet for one supported seller. The
wallet flow will expose quoted, awaiting approval, confirming, settled and
failed states only after each state is enforced by the payment system.
claims.proposed_statement: Tix’s roadmap includes supported marketplace sources, selected notifications and an optional wallet for a supported seller.
claims.required_qualifier: Explicit future tense. No existing coverage, notification delivery or wallet execution claim.
claims.editorial_assessment: The complete roadmap paragraph preserves dependencies instead of promising availability.

claims.quote:
A consumer wallet is optional. The planned flow gives the user
a scoped spending permission with an amount cap, expiry, approval and
revocation. Deposits and purchases stay outside the consumer preview until a
supported seller and the full permission-to-receipt path are verified.
claims.proposed_statement: The planned purchase flow uses an optional wallet and spending permission with a cap, expiry, approval and revocation.
claims.required_qualifier: Explicitly planned; keep supported seller and verification prerequisites. Do not say that connecting a wallet enables purchases today.
claims.editorial_assessment: This excerpt excludes the preceding historical transaction claim and carries the future-flow conditions.

claims.quote:
[tixmancer.xyz](https://tixmancer.xyz) is the canonical product domain. The
server can run it as a restricted preview or as a public waitlist.
claims.proposed_statement: The product’s canonical address is tixmancer.xyz.
claims.required_qualifier: The domain is supported. An active public waitlist collection flow was not verified.
claims.editorial_assessment: The canonical domain supports the chosen destination without inventing deployment state.

held_or_excluded.statement: Tix has found an item below market value or guarantees savings.
held_or_excluded.reason: The selected source supports comparison with a personal limit; market-value evidence is absent.

held_or_excluded.statement: Tix currently searches Craigslist or Facebook Marketplace for users.
held_or_excluded.reason: Real listing photos in the film are creative source assets. No live marketplace integration was verified.

held_or_excluded.statement: Tix currently funds a consumer wallet or automatically purchases marketplace goods.
held_or_excluded.reason: The selected preview simulates wallet steps; purchasing is a future supported-seller flow.

held_or_excluded.statement: The deployed account login and model conversation have passed live acceptance.
held_or_excluded.reason: Code presence is established; this baseline performed no authenticated provider journey.

held_or_excluded.statement: A historical 5.00 test USDC transaction establishes consumer marketplace checkout.
held_or_excluded.reason: Historical text remains in the frozen documents for context. No chain re-verification ran, and the documented demo-seller proof cannot establish consumer purchasing.

held_or_excluded.statement: Tix has specific pricing plans, existing customers, an affiliate program, funding or measured business results.
held_or_excluded.reason: No selected evidence establishes these claims. Email audience labels are test contexts.

held_or_excluded.statement: The public waitlist collection flow is working at the chosen destination.
held_or_excluded.reason: Home and roadmap text were retrieved without interaction; /waitlist returned404. The approved CTA remains a creative decision, with collection verification due before publication.

scenario.use: Illustrative buyer brief only; not a product cap, offer, result or testimonial
